description:
Billing & dunning (Abrechnung) for Energy Community tenants — EC v2 line
(ADR 0001, AB#4552). Settlements are computed from STREAM DATA
(Basic.Energy/EnergyMeasurement over the raw archive energy-measurements
ec0000000000000000000a01), not from the retired EnergyCommunity/EnergyQuantity
runtime entities.

Installs:
- 11 billing pipelines: create/release/send/unrelease/cancel for billing documents
  and items (single + all variants; send-all is an HTTP trigger plus its worker)
- 1 messaging pipeline: sendMessage (ad-hoc member messaging — AB#4292; sends a
  notification template to an explicit list of recipient email addresses)
- 6 billing/reporting queries (_energy_billing_documents, _energy_billing_items,
  reporting_energy_billing_items, pipeline_energy_billings,
  pipeline_customer_meteringpoints, and the stream-data settlement query
  billing-energy-by-quality ec000000000000000000e001)
- billing-overview MeshBoard (AB#4578): System.UI/Dashboard
  energy-community-accounting + 10 widgets, backed by 6 new
  GroupingAggregationRtQuery board queries (ec00…0e01–0e06) over the EC v2
  Customer / BillingDocument / BillingDocumentLineItem types; the 2
  metering-value widgets bind to the Base stream-data queries (…a22/…a23)
- 6 notification templates with neutral default text:
  - mail-notification-template (quarterly billing email)
  - mail-notification-template-q2 (quarterly billing variant)
  - offene-abrechnung (open invoice reminder)
  - offene-gutschrift (open credit note reminder)
  - prae-zahlungserinnerung (pre-payment-reminder)

Notification templates are seeded with neutral placeholders — customize per tenant
(replace organisation name, IBAN, signature etc.) in Refinery Studio.

Settlement (create-billing-items) sums amount.value per metering point over the
billing period, only for L1/L2 quality intervals, by scoping a persisted
GroupingAggregationSdQuery (billing-energy-by-quality) to the metering point's
EnergyMeasurement anchor rtIds via GetQueryById@1 node fieldFilters
(rtId IN anchors, window_start/window_end within the period). Each
BillingDocumentLineItem persists the summed quantity, the billed TimeRange, the
total intervalCount and the L1/L2/L3/Unknown quality distribution (ADR 0001
decision 3), replacing the removed AssignedBilling -> EnergyQuantity associations.

AB#3717, the public member-registration backend, ships in 2.3.0 as well. It was built as a
2.2.0 iteration on the branch and published 2.2.0 - the version on main - contains none of
it, so no tenant has any of this under that number. A DataFlow
(ec0000000000000000000901), the anonymous POST /member-registration pipeline
(ec0000000000000000000902), the confirmation-mail template (ec0000000000000000000903), the
endpoint configuration carrying the Turnstile secret (ec0000000000000000000904) and the mail
pipeline (ec0000000000000000000905). In Billing rather than Base because Billing is what
gates personal data: AB#4718 and AB#4719 define a Billing-less tenant as one that captures
none, and AB#4717 gates /customers and /email-templates on this blueprint.

The CK pin lives only in the seed files under seedDataPaths, which is what the install path
resolves. UpdateBlueprint builds its import root from the manifest instead, so on that path
the pin is not checked and a missing model surfaces later and less clearly.

2.3.0 (AB#3719): the operator is told, decides, and the applicant hears back. One MINOR over
2.2.0 - the change set is additive, and the interim versions of several tenant iterations are
deliberately not published.

2.3.0 -> 2.4.0: the settlement bills what was settled, not everything the archive holds for
the metering point. Three defects of the two create-items pipelines
(createAllBillingItemsForPeriod, createBillingItems), found by re-settling octogrid against
its released 3.x line items (AB#4556); none showed on create-demo-community, whose simulator
emits a single register over the demo period only:
- Only the billed OBIS register is summed (AB#5239). A metering point carries several
  registers, and the settlement summed all of them - a consumer came out 18 to 44 times too
  high. The register follows the 1.x ingest, which fixed it in code: a consumer bills
  1-1:2.9.0 G.03, a producer 1-1:2.9.0 G.01T minus 1-1:2.9.0 P.01T. A Switch on the metering
  point's CkTypeId selects it; a producer runs the query a second time for P.01T and
  subtracts (the two registers are reported for the same intervals). A role that names no
  register produces no line item.
- The requested period is settled. A Project@1 removed $.body, the period bounds resolved to
  null, and a field filter without a value is dropped by the stream-data layer - every line
  item billed its metering point's whole archive history.
- A metering point without an EnergyMeasurement anchor produces no line item. Its empty
  `rtId In` filter was dropped the same way, and it was billed the whole community's energy.
Amounts on tenants that already billed with 2.x change accordingly; issued documents are not
touched. The CK floors move with Base 2.6.0 (Basic.Energy 1.7, EnergyCommunity 4.6).
The registration seeds pin EnergyCommunity.Registration-[2.4,3.0): a compiled model carries
exact dependency versions, and 2.3.x was compiled against EnergyCommunity 4.3.0 / Basic.Energy
1.4.0, so it cannot be imported next to the 4.6.0 set. Registration 2.4.0 is the same model
rebuilt against it (Basic 2.1.0, Basic.Energy 1.7.0, EnergyCommunity 4.6.0); import it before
this version, as for 2.3.0.

- The submission pipeline stamps State = New; Basic.Energy/State defaults to Active, so an
  unstamped application read back as the state acceptance is supposed to produce.
- The mail pipeline gained a guarded send to the operator (template …906), addressed to
  RegistrationConfiguration.NotificationRecipients - a StringArray on the model this
  repository owns, editable in Settings. An empty list skips the send rather than failing a
  pipeline whose applicant confirmation has already gone out. That send runs LAST for the same
  reason: SendEMail@2 throws without calling next(), so one send can kill the other, and the
  applicant has no second channel while the operator has the Registration Requests page.
- The Turnstile secret and the recipient list are isRuntimeState now. Both are seeded EMPTY
  and an install is an Upsert over the whole document, so every upgrade used to empty them:
  the CAPTCHA went off and the operator stopped being told anybody had applied.
- member-registration-decision (…90a) mails the applicant one of three templates: accepted
  (…907), denied-with-reason (…908) or denied (…909). Three because a NotificationTemplate has
  no conditionals and the reason is optional. It is the first route here that is NOT
  anonymous, and it reads the application rather than the request body - so the caller must
  ask for it BEFORE archiving a refusal.
- member-registration-community (…90b) answers the community's Name on an anonymous GET, so
  the public page can say what somebody is applying to. Read-only: its nginx location denies
  every method but GET.
- The CAPTCHA is REQUIRED, with no way to turn it off. It is the only barrier in front of an
  anonymous write route, so a tenant with no CaptchaSecret takes no applications at all: the
  route refuses with a message naming the configuration rather than blaming the applicant, and
  logs the reason. The public page shows "registration is not available" when no site key is
  configured, instead of a form that would be refused at the end.
- Defects the end-to-end run found, fixed in this version rather than shipped: the decision
  route answered {"response":{...}} while the caller reads `status` at the top level; the
  decision templates rendered first, last AND company name; and a body without `meteringPoints`
  answered HTTP 500.
- The submission is validated in the pipeline before anything is written: every metering
  point number against the 33-character AT/DE scheme and against the others in the list (one
  number, once), the quantities by type and against absurdity bounds, every text against the
  200 characters the form allows, the billing and per-point addresses for presence, a
  producer for a production type the model knows, and the list against a cap of fifty. The route is anonymous and acceptance creates entities
  with fromStore, which skips the write validation, so the form's own validators guard
  nothing here. Done in ExecuteCSharp@1 because ForEach@1 runs each iteration in a child
  context and discards everything but MergePath - a flag raised inside the loop never
  reaches the caller.
- An address that has already applied gets the SAME answer as a new one. The route is
  anonymous, so a refusal a caller could recognise told it which addresses belong to
  applicants and to members - accepted applications stay readable, only refused ones are
  archived. Nothing new is stored, the operator is not notified twice, and the address owner
  is told by mail (template ...90c) on a channel the caller cannot read.

The CK pin moves to EnergyCommunity.Registration-[2.3,3.0). Redeploy the DataFlow after
installing, and see Post-install for the SMTP Uses association.

Prerequisites:
- An octo-mesh-adapter that knows the registration placeholder source. The templates are built
  from ${registration.*} tokens, and ResolveNotificationPlaceholders@1 REFUSES a send whose
  token its catalog does not know - so no mail goes out at all, unseen, because the handoff is
  fire-and-forget. It ships on dev/int64/energy-community-public-member-registration and must
  be released BEFORE this blueprint reaches a tenant.
- EnergyCommunity.Registration CK model imported BEFORE this blueprint. It is owned by this
  repository (ck/) and is NOT in the shared catalog, so the seed dependency only checks what
  the tenant already has - see docs/DEPLOYMENT.md for the two commands. Without it the install
  fails, which is the intended outcome: the endpoint would otherwise fail at runtime with
  "RtCkRecordId ... not found in CkCache".
  ONCE THE MODEL IS PUBLISHED by the shared CK step (AB#5101 / AB#5121; ck/Registration.csproj
  already carries OctoPublishCkModel), this whole prerequisite goes away: add
  `ckModelDependencies: [EnergyCommunity.Registration-[2.4,3.0)]` to this manifest and the
  engine resolves and installs the model itself. Not before - a pin the catalogs cannot
  resolve fails the install everywhere.
- EnergyCommunity.Base 2.x installed (stream-data archives + rollup ladder,
  ActivateArchive done; provides the raw archive ec0000000000000000000a01)

2.4.0 -> 2.4.1: the two period-wide actions of the app work like their single-document
siblings. Both follow what the 1.x line does and the app already expects:
- Releasing a period uses the community's own report. Release-all named the literals
  Billing.trdp / Billing_, because GenerateAndStoreReport@1 takes neither from a path, so a
  community whose report carries another name - whatever billingReportName says - could
  release a single document but not a period. It now calls the reporting API the way
  /releaseBillingDocument does (MakeHttpRequest@1 on the caller's reportUrlTemplate) with
  billingReportName and billingReportFilePrefix from the configuration, and carries the Uses
  association that lookup needs (1.x: AB#4412). billingReportName has to name a report the
  tenant holds; billingReportFilePrefix is passed on as it is, an empty one included.
- Sending a period hands the request to a worker and sends the chosen template. The app
  passes the template picked in the send dialog (notificationTemplateRtWellKnownName,
  AB#3979) and then polls the executions of the worker pipeline 6a61b2a10238868d3c2bfa5c
  (AB#4508); the seed sent inline with the fixed template billing-quarterly-q2 and had no
  such pipeline, so the dialog's choice was ignored and the app waited for a run that never
  started. The data flow is now the HTTP trigger 689f3398…, which answers
  {"accepted": true} at once, plus the worker, which sends and persists
  {billingItems: {TotalCount}} as its execution result.
The worker is a new pipeline that sends mail: link the tenant's billing-smtp to it
(System.Communication/Uses) before deploying the data flow, as for the other sending
pipelines (see Post-install).

2.1.2 (AB#4633): fresh-tenant billing fixes surfaced by the EC v2 demo cycle:
(1) the two create-items pipelines (createAllBillingItemsForPeriod,
createBillingItems) now carry a System.Communication/Uses association to the
Base-seeded EnergyCommunityConfiguration (69775cca…) — without it
GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName@1 fails with HTTP 500
("'EnergyCommunityConfiguration' not found in GlobalConfiguration") on a fresh
install; (2) the two create-documents pipelines
(createAllBillingDocumentsForPeriod, createBillingDocuments) now ship
DeploymentState DEPLOYED (2) to match the create-items pipelines, so the whole
create chain is live after install (previously the documents endpoint 404'd
until a manual DeployDataFlow). The lifecycle pipelines
(release/send/cancel/unrelease/sendMessage) still ship undeployed (0) — deploy
them on demand.

2.1.3 (AB#4554 — de-SBEG-ing): the report / SMTP / BCC / notification-template
values are no longer hardcoded SBEG strings. The report/release/send/message
pipelines now carry a System.Communication/Uses association to the Base-seeded
EnergyCommunityConfiguration (69775cca…) and load it via
GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName@1, resolving:
  - report URI     ← billingReportName        (MakeHttpRequest@1 valuePath)
  - report prefix  ← billingReportFilePrefix   (MakeHttpRequest@1 valuePath)
  - BCC address    ← notificationEmailContact  (SendEMail@1 bccPath)
Two node fields have no *Path variant in their schema and stay tenant-neutral
literals instead: SendEMail@1.serverConfiguration (= 'billing-smtp'; each tenant
provides an EMailSenderConfiguration with that well-known name — mirrors
EnergyCommunityConfiguration.billingMailServerConfiguration) and
GenerateAndStoreReport@1.reportDefinitionUri/reportFileNamePrefix (the single-
document /releaseBillingDocument pipeline is the config-driven path). Attachment
filename and the notification-template name are neutralized (Abrechnung.pdf /
billing-quarterly-q2). Requires System.Communication 3.31.0 for BankAccountIban,
BankAccountHolder and EmailFooterImage — the first two read as a runtime entity
rather than through GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName@1, because the typed config
DTO only carries what the controller binary's own CK model declares. Installing
this blueprint against an older System.Communication leaves the two attributes absent,
and ResolveNotificationPlaceholders@1 treats a present entity with a missing value as
empty by data: it substitutes nothing and warns, so offene-abrechnung goes out asking a
member to pay into a blank account. The same happens on a current model whenever nobody
fills the two fields in Settings — the node refuses only when a whole source entity was
never supplied, never on an unset attribute.
Also requires an adapter that registers SendEMail@2 and ResolveNotificationPlaceholders@1.

Post-install:
- Customize notification templates in Refinery Studio
- Provide an EMailSenderConfiguration named 'billing-smtp' (or edit the pipelines)
  and fill EnergyCommunityConfiguration billing fields in Refinery Studio, then
  ASSOCIATE it (System.Communication/Uses) to every pipeline that sends mail. The name in
  SendEMail@2.serverConfiguration is only resolved against the pipeline's own
  GlobalConfiguration, which is built from its Uses associations - and the entity is created
  per tenant, so no blueprint can seed the association. Without it the node fails with
  "Global configuration parameter 'ServerConfiguration' with value 'billing-smtp' not found"
  on the FIRST send, not at install or deploy time. The association is read when the DataFlow
  is deployed, so add it and then DeployDataFlow. This covers the registration pipelines
  ec0000000000000000000905 and ec000000000000000000090a as well as the billing
  send/message pipelines (684ad571876fb5d86c6a229a, the send-all worker
  6a61b2a10238868d3c2bfa5c, ec000000000000000000d002).
- The billing create chain (create documents + items) ships DEPLOYED (2); the
  release/send/cancel/unrelease/sendMessage lifecycle pipelines ship undeployed —
  DeployDataFlow those on demand. All are pre-assigned to the Mesh Adapter
  (670…002) via Executes-1, no manual assignment needed.
- Configure the SMTP notification target for outbound mail

2.2.0 splits the seed across one file per topic (AB#4758 `seedDataPaths`) —
identical entities, no data change. It therefore requires an engine that knows
`seedDataPaths`: an older engine drops the unknown property, finds no
`seedDataPath` and installs an EMPTY seed while still reporting success.
Install 2.1.7 on such tenants.

2.3.0 follows that split rather than reopening the single file: the registration
entities live in seed-data/data-flows/member-registration.yaml (the DataFlow and its
four pipelines), seed-data/notifications/registration-templates.yaml (the six mail
templates) and seed-data/configurations/registration.yaml (the endpoint
configuration). Those three declare the raised CK floors and the
EnergyCommunity.Registration pin, which the manifest merges with the rest.
